desc: The Browning Citori 825 over/under 12 gauge shotgun features Western-themed receiver engraving; tailored for sporting clays and skeet competition; Grade II Turkish walnut stock; matte blued barrel; Triple Trigger System with three trigger shoes; HiViz Pro Comp sight and Midas Grade Invector-DS Choke Tube System. Includes 5 extended Midas Grade choke tubes.
